query: SELECT p.matchupId, p.pickedTeamId, gr.winnerId, t1.name as pickedTeam, t2.name as winnerTeam FROM picks p JOIN gameResults gr ON gr.matchupId = p.matchupId JOIN teams t1 ON t1.id = p.pickedTeamId LEFT JOIN teams t2 ON t2.id = gr.winnerId WHERE gr.isComplete = 1 LIMIT 10;
